source: make me a lobby with a water fountain in the middle

image_prompt.text: An open lobby floor sized for a crowd to congregate in
A water fountain in the middle of the lobby as the distinct structure the whole space reads from
The arrival point, oriented so the fountain is the first thing a player sees

layout_placement.text: Where players enter the lobby, placed so the first view is composed on the fountain

notes: A lobby normally implies a game it is a lobby for, but none was named, so this builds as a place under no-genre rather than inventing a genre.
Enclosure set to interior-only because a lobby is an indoor room; that axis carries no pipeline cost.
The fountain is carried as the orientation landmark, bent from its usual read as a distant outdoor structure to a room centrepiece.

open_questions.ask: No look was stated - marble and glass hotel lobby, or something more stylized and cartoony?
Is this the lobby for a game with rounds or minigames, or just a place to hang out? A round lobby usually wants teleporters and a queue area.

coverage_missing.ask: No look was stated - marble and glass hotel lobby, or something stylized?
Is this the lobby for a game with rounds or minigames, or just a hangout?
How many players should it comfortably hold?

answers.ask: No look was stated - marble and glass hotel lobby, or something more stylized and cartoony?
answers.answer: Use a marble and glass hotel-lobby look, with the water fountain as the central focal point.

answers.ask: Is this the lobby for a game with rounds or minigames, or just a place to hang out? A round lobby usually wants teleporters and a queue area.
answers.answer: This is just a place to hang out; do not add round teleporters or a queue area.
